demo.code:
You:   @bankrbot market this: Will ETH close above $4,000 on Sep 19, 2026?
Bankr: Draft, not live yet: "Will ETH close above $4,000 on Sep 19, 2026?"
       YES / NO · betting closes Sep 19 20:00 UTC · you resolve it by Sep 22 20:00 UTC
       Reply "confirm" to publish.
You:   confirm
Bankr: Live. Settled by you. No bets yet: you set the odds.
       bazaar.playhunch.xyz/markets/<id>

— a friend, in the thread —
Them:  @bankrbot bet $5 YES on bazaar.playhunch.xyz/markets/<id>
Bankr: $5.00 on YES pays $7.48 (1.49x) if YES wins against the pool as it stands.
       Reply "confirm" to pay $5.00 USDC from your Bankr wallet.

setup: X market creation uses Bankr native `sign_data` and permanent wallet files; no API key or environment variables required
Fund your Bankr wallet with USDC on Base; a bet is $0.50 minimum with no Hunch maximum (Bankr's own limits apply)
Make a market: `@bankrbot market this: <question>`, then reply `confirm` to the preview
Only the creator resolves or voids; a market unresolved 48h past its deadline refunds every bettor in full

Payments go to a Hunch-controlled settlement account, not rule-enforcing market escrow. Bet recording, payouts and promised refunds depend on the operator; a payment receipt alone does not prove them.
